[[Mahk Jenshan]] can be found on guard duty just outside the entrance to the [[Citadel of Dzagon]].

==Location==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Wilderness of Bahdza}}

==Dialogue==
:''"I'm what you might call a professional amateur. Yes, I guard the tower, and yes, I keep the roads safe. But this is just my temp job. I'm really a game designer! You know...toys...for children." ''

==Quotes==
:''"Want to try my new wind-up pony? You can keep it, but you'll have to come back every month to get it wound up again.... for a small fee of course.... Hey, wait! Where are you going?"''
:''"What do you like better...a water lantern with wax lumps floating inside, or a hat knitted in the shape of a squid? I'm leaning toward the squid-hat, personally..."''

==Trivia==
*The first quote refers to online games that require a monthly fee to play, since [[Guild Wars]] has no such requirement.
*The second quote refers to a lava lamp (Perhaps the one in the "Making of..." DVD in the [[Guild_Wars_Nightfall#Guild_Wars_Nightfall_Collector.27s_Edition_.28box_content.29|Guild Wars Nightfall Collector's Edition]] at 0:04:20), and a squid-shaped hat made by [[Katy Hargrove]].
*Mahk Jenshan is named after an Alpha tester.
